title: Deeper/broader independent-reader license, parser-safety, and consumer-route review
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Assess LibreDWG's current AcDs reader route, security history, and source license as a comparator for libdxfrw
Separate DXF parser support from peer writer/native acceptance for 3DSOLID and related carriers
Pin FreeCAD converter/importer route dimensions and LibreCAD 3 feature configuration requirements
Refine existing 2D compatibility, 3D carrier, semantic, and fast-validation owners without creating new gates

method.kind: Read current upstream source, release history, official application documentation, and reconcile with local implementation plans
method.limitations: GitHub master and official documentation pages are mutable. No peer behavior or issue report was reproduced. Source claims are route discovery only; ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout. No local defect was established.

sources.observed: The source has a dedicated read_2007_section_acds() entry route into acds_private()/acds.spec for AcDsPrototype_1b. The project exposes a document comparing its internal ODA 5.4.2 specification to LibreDWG implementation behavior. This identifies a useful structure comparator and investigation index, but does not prove complete entity-owner association, ACIS body semantics, or conformance for an unpinned build. The local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative.

sources.project: LibreDWG release security history and license
sources.revision: NEWS entry for 0.14.1 dated 2026-07-25; repository license reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The release history records fixes for an R2004 section-decompression heap overflow, a pre-R2004 VIEWPORT import use-after-free, and an R2004 section-page-map out-of-bounds read. These are not evidence of local libdxfrw defects; they are relevant regression classes for the existing parser-hardening owners. LibreDWG is GPL-3.0-or-later, so source reuse in the LibreCAD downstream path needs separate maintainer/license-compatibility review; behavioral comparison does not require source reuse.

The repository lists typed DXF 3DSOLID, BODY, and REGION entities, but explicitly cautions that AutoCAD might not open files written with several such entity types. This is a project-level warning and not proof that all output is invalid. It supports treating reader/model coverage separately from writer/native acceptance.

FreeCAD's DWG path uses an external converter followed by the selected DXF importer; documented converter choices include LibreDWG, ODA File Converter, and QCAD Pro. DXF importer choice is configurable between a newer C++ implementation and a legacy Python implementation with differing feature coverage. Stock DXF import does not consume embedded ACIS solids. A FreeCAD result must therefore identify the exact converter, output revision/artifact, importer backend, and relevant preferences; it cannot establish ACIS/B-rep semantics.

The documentation states that DWG import is behind WITH_DWG_IMPORT, off by default, and read-only, and describes a read-direction evidence ledger. Downstream qualification must pin the source revision and explicitly enable the feature; default-build absence and DWG writing are not the same route. This is a compatibility consumer, not an ACIS semantic witness.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing PAR-07/S8, writer-acceptance, security-hardening, FreeCAD platform-qualification, and LibreCAD adapter-compatibility owners. Peer admission now records license/revision/build/route; FreeCAD qualification pins converter plus importer backend; writer readback is not treated as native acceptance; security examples map to existing bounds, lifetime, and decompression controls. Local fast-slice cadence and implementation queue are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Use immutable peer revisions and capture repository URL, license, binary/source hash, build options, OS, format/version/direction, exact command, and diagnostics; classify unavailable or ambiguous evidence as NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED.
Use LibreDWG's ODA implementation-difference PDF only to locate questions; adjudicate DWG bytes with the local ODA v5.4.1 PDF and an empirical sample trace.
Do not port GPL-3.0-or-later source into the LibreCAD downstream path without a separate maintainer/license-compatibility review; prefer specification-led implementation.

For FreeCAD Linux and Windows runs, capture exact app and converter revisions, converter selection, requested/actual DXF version, intermediate DXF hash, importer backend, and relevant import preferences. Test only the route actually claimed; an alternate backend is an optional distinct matrix row.
Keep 2D compatibility, explicit 3D geometry, opaque SAT/SAB/AcDs payload preservation, ACIS parsing, B-rep semantics, and native application acceptance as separate results.
Treat peer entity readers as reader evidence only when the peer documents writer acceptance caveats; require an independent reopen/native check for writer claims.

Map peer security reports to existing local bounds, decompression-size, progress, and object-lifetime owners. Add a focused in-memory regression to the existing owner only after confirming an uncovered local gap.
Retain strict owning-target build + focused selector + owning CTest for each local slice. Defer full suites, fuzzing, sanitizers, broad corpus, peer, and native-app runs to existing composed gates.
After each implementation item, update the plan with result, remaining evidence boundary, and next actionable local item; mark external evidence unavailable and continue without waiting.
